text:
Kevin: Quick sync — ACME Systems (enterprise) asked for a private/VPC deployment. Sales needs a feasibility check + rough cost/timeline so we can include in the proposal by Fri. Key asks: VPC peering, BYO hardware option, HSM/KMS, SSO/SAML, and PCI data isolation. Any immediate blockers? cc @maya @sam

Maya: Thanks — can you drop the customer's security checklist and expected traffic profile? Need peak RPS and tokens/sec to size GPU pool and network.

Kevin: Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-1128
Customer notes copied: "peak inference 120 qps, bursts to 400 qps for 5-10m, model: open-llama-13b quantized, data residency: EU; requires KMS-backed keywrap; will run in their Azure tenancy"

Sam: High level dependencies from infra side:
```
- Private control plane (VPC peering or transit)
- Image packaging + private registry auth
- KMS/HSM integration (Azure Key Vault / BYOK)
- Network egress policies and VPN setup
- Ops runbook + support oncall rotation
```
We'll also need a signed NDA + access window to their test VPC.

Priya: Security notes: we need the customer's complete compliance pack. For PCI-ish workloads we require: HSM or managed KMS with key separation, audit logging retention, and explicit data flow diagrams. Also confirm that model weights are allowed to be hosted inside their tenancy (some legal teams restrict).

Jonah: Runtime notes: open-llama-13b quantized should run on our 80GB-ish GPUs but kernel/quantization variants matter. If they insist on BYO hardware we'll need a preflight compatibility checklist (CUDA version, MIG support, NCCL, kernel patches). Without that we should propose a staged approach: POC on Redwood Dedicated (to validate prompts/latency) then handoff to their infra.

Kevin: Customer is open to a paid POC and can give a two-week access window starting Apr 6. They prefer an estimate for a 3-month rollout and a not-to-exceed figure for the POC.

Maya: Proposed acceptance criteria for product backlog item (suggested):
1) Automated installer (Helm + tfvars) that can deploy Control Plane + Runtime into customer VPC
2) KMS/HSM integration validated end-to-end with keywrap and rotation tests
3) e2e smoke tests run inside customer's test VPC (latency SLOs and token throughput validated)
4) Docs: runbook, troubleshooting, rollback plan
5) SLA and support handoff agreed

Sam: Rough engineering estimate: core infra + packaging + e2e = 2-3 sprints (if no HSM). HSM/KMS + legal/compliance + customer network windows add 2-3 more sprints. So 4-6 sprint range total. If they pay for POC we can compress to 3 sprints prioritized.

Priya: Compliance gating: need SOC2/ISO attestation copies and their DPO contact. Also confirm retention windows and whether token logs may be redacted.

Jonah: Small technical ask: can we get a sample prompt set and a 1-hour trace of token distribution? That will help pick quantization profile and batching config.

Kevin: I'll request the prompt set and security pack today. Also confirming they can provide the POC funding.

Maya: OK — owners + next steps:
- Kevin: collect security pack + prompt set + confirm POC budget (due Tue)
- Sam: draft internal dependency checklist and rough runbook (due Wed)
- Jonah: prepare runtime compatibility checklist for BYO hardware (due Wed)
- Priya: list compliance gating items and required docs (due Wed)

If everyone agrees, I'll slot this into the Product backlog and mark as "sales-triage: private deploy" with priority P1 for POC. Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or call out concerns.
